# E0308: translating an instance, a lens failed

Translating an instance, a lens failed to evaluate: for this instance, a
mapping produced a value the target schema rejects. The primary position is
the mapping, since a translation failure is always a bug in the lens, and CUE's
account is in the detail. The totality checker refuses such a lens at bind
(E0367); this is what remains when it does not run, as under SkipBuggyChecks
here.

## Example

`lineage.cue`:

```cue
name: "ship"
schemas: {
	"0": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				a: int & >=0
			}
		}
	}
	"1": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				n: int & >=0
			}
		}
	}
}
lenses: {
	"0.0->1.0": {
		v0_0: _
		v1_0: {
			n: v0_0.a - 1
		}
	}
	"1.0->0.0": {
		v1_0: _
		v0_0: {
			a: v1_0.n
		}
	}
}
```

`data.json`:

```json
{
	"a": 0
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0308]: n in the result of lens 0.0->1.0 failed for this instance
  --> lineage.cue:22:7
   |
13 |                 n: int & >=0
   |                          - also here
...
22 |             n: v0_0.a - 1
   |                ^^^^
   |
   = detail: lenses.0.0->1.0.v1_0.n: invalid value -1 (out of bound >=0)
```
